turns.text: Good morning! Welcome to Roasters. What can I get started for you today?
Hi there! Could I get an iced oat latte with half sugar, please?
turns.ipa: /haɪ ðɛər/ | /kʊd aɪ ɡet/ | /ən aɪst oʊt ˈlɑːteɪ/ | /wɪð hæf ˈʃʊɡər pliːz/

turns.text: Sure thing! What size would you like: 12, 16, or 20 ounce? And do you want any extra ice?
A 16-ounce medium would be great. And could you go light on the ice, please?
You got it. Anything else — maybe a pastry to go with that?
No thanks, that's all. Could I pay by card?

title: Checking In at Airport Hotel Late Night

turns.text: Good evening, welcome to the Skyline Hotel. How can I help you tonight?
Good evening. I have a reservation under Lin, but my flight got delayed.
No problem at all. May I see your passport and the booking confirmation?
Of course, here they are. I booked a king room for three nights.
I see it here. Since you arrived after midnight, would you like a late checkout tomorrow?
That would be lovely, but I have an early meeting. Could I get a wake-up call instead?
Absolutely — seven o'clock. Your room is on the fifth floor, just past the tea lounge.
Perfect, thank you. Is breakfast included with the stay?

title: Introducing Yourself in a Team Standup

turns.text: Morning, everyone! Let's kick off. New faces first — go ahead!
Hey everyone, excited to be here! Yesterday I spent time setting up the local repo...
Nice. Any blockers we should know about before you start on the API?
Just one — I'm waiting on staging credentials, but I can work on the docs meanwhile.
I'll ping the platform team. Anything you'd like to ask the group?
Actually yes — who should I talk to about the deploy checklist?

title: Handling an Incorrect Food Delivery
goal: Calm assertiveness without awkward filler pauses

turns.text: Thanks for calling FreshBowl support. What seems to be the problem?
Hi, I just opened order #402, and the avocado roll was missing.
I'm sorry about that. Would you like a refund for the roll or a replacement?
A refund would be best. Could you also let the kitchen know for next time?
Done. The refund should appear in three to five business days.

title: Explaining Why You're Late with Natural Politeness

turns.text: There you are! I was starting to think the subway swallowed you.
I'm so sorry to keep you waiting! The subway had an unexpected signal delay.
turns.ipa: /aɪm soʊ ˈsɑri tu kip ju ˈweɪtɪŋ/

turns.text: No worries at all. They just sat us, and I ordered you a matcha.
You're a lifesaver. Next round of tea is on me, I promise.

title: Casual Weekend Small Talk with a Neighbor

turns.text: Morning! Lovely day, isn't it?
Great weather we're having today, isn't it? Are you heading out to the park?
I am — thought I'd catch the morning light before work. You?
Same here. I usually walk a loop before the café gets busy.
Smart. Have you tried the new place on the corner? Their hojicha latte is dangerous.
Not yet! I'll have to check it out. Maybe we can walk over on Saturday?
Deal. I'll text you — enjoy your loop!
Hey Tom, are you working late again?
Yeah, Peter. I have a big project I'm working on
How's it going?
Not well. We keep running into problems with the client.
What kind of problems?
The client either doesn't like our designs or keeps changing his mind. It's very frustrating.
That can be very annoying
It is. My group has start over each time. It such a waste of time and money.
Where is the rest of your group?
They went to eat. I told them to go. They'er going to bring me back some dinner.
That's good. What are you going to do after your deadline is over?
Go on a long vacation.
Good for you.
Well, I better get back to work. See you in the morning.
